entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 4081642115877635840: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 93683: distance 43.554 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.01), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 43.554 +/- 0.436 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 23.8121 +/- 0.1518 mas (same row, RUWE 2.48), 156.9 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 77.445, -58.460 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 4081642115877635840 (quality A), from 2006AstL...32..759G; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 10.921 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 93683: radius 10.921 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 61.216 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.052) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4889 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 93683: effective temperature 4889 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.046).
